## Release boundaries

- [ ] No credentials, real prompts, session IDs, personal paths, or private logs included.
- [ ] Candidate tree and built contents inspected; history scans described separately.
- [ ] No permission bypass, unbounded retry, or raw default logging introduced.
- [ ] No main merge, force update, visibility change, or publication without owner approval.
- [ ] Claims in README match demonstrated behavior.
